title: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip6 512GB Silver Shadow
description: This Samsung Galaxy Flip6 is a pocket-sized powerhouse that flips open to reveal a full sized 6.7" display. The outer FlexWindow display provides updates in response to changes such as the weather² and can be used in conjunction with the upgraded 50MP camera and AI powered auto zoom⁷ and framing to find the perfect angles for your photos. Plus, with Live Translate, you can listen to foreign languages in your preferred one during phone calls⁴.
descriptions: It features a 6.7" folding inner display as well as the outer FlexWindow which can create generative wallpapers ² and provide automatic updates reflecting real world changes¹⁰.
Every shot is a good shot with built-in AI auto-zoom⁶, ⁷ and 50MP camera.
It comes with 12 GB of RAM.
It has a storage capacity of 512 GB.
It runs on the Android 14 operating system.
This phone supports connections via WiFi 6E, Bluetooth 5.3 and USB-C.
Simply connect to the network using a nano-SIM.
It comes with a 2 year warranty for added peace of mind.
This phone is unlocked so you can connect it to the Australian network of your choice.
It comes in a stylish silver shadow design.
The 4000mAh battery helps you get the most out of your whole day, while the new vapour chamber keeps your phone running cool.
With FlexMode you can discover all the degrees of possibility with hands-free streaming, photography and video calls.
You can speak the same language during face-to-face chats or calls with Live Translation working in real time⁴.
It's built with armour aluminium casing⁹, upgraded Gorilla Glass Victus 2⁸, and a dual rail hinge to provide protection from bumps and accidental scratches.

title: Samsung Galaxy S26+ 256GB Black
description: Introducing the new Galaxy S26+, your true AI companion. Seize the day, effortlessly, with intelligently intuitive Galaxy AI designed to elevate your everyday moments¹. Your biggest moments just got bigger with an epic 50MP camera and high resolution Nightography² – for stunning clarity, anytime of day. Immerse yourself in other worlds and places whilst you scroll, watch, play or work, with its expansive and immersive 6.7”³ QHD+ Dynamic AMOLED 2X display and AI powered ProScaler⁴ for mind-blowing graphic detail.
descriptions: Experience a smarter way to live with Galaxy AI, making everyday moments effortless. From intelligent photo editing, to instant summaries¹ and smarter search, Galaxy AI helps you do more, faster. It learns how you work, adapts to your needs, and becomes your ultimate AI assistant – built for the way you live.

Experience unmatched performance. The Galaxy S26+ is powered by the latest processor, delivering faster speeds and extra efficiency for seamless gaming and epic entertainment. Stay at the top of your game with a self-optimising battery that you can rely on, all day.⁵

Make every memory one to keep with an epic 50MP camera.  Capture your favourite moments with friends and family in stunning clarity, whether you’re soaking up the sun at the beach, or on a night out after dark, thanks to high-resolution Nightography².  Experience photo-editing freedom with Galaxy AI¹, letting you instantly search, add or remove objects and reimagine your photos by using prompts from your gallery.  It’s never been easier to unleash your creativity.

Whether you’re deep in a gaming session, streaming your favourite series or multitasking on-the-go, the Galaxy S26+ features an expansive 6.7”³ QHD+ screen for a completely immersive experience.  Step into new worlds with a Dynamic AMOLED 2X display and AI powered ProScaler⁴, delivering higher image quality and advanced ray tracing for mind-blowing graphic detail.

Slide the Galaxy S26+ seamlessly into your pocket – slim with rounded edges made for comfort. Feel good about a design that is built for you, with One UI 8.5 that brings customisable Quick panel icons and flexible Lock Screen layouts.

title: Samsung Galaxy S25 256GB Navy
description: Introducing the new Galaxy S25, the epic next wave of smartphone technology. Tackle your day with ease with the help of even smarter Galaxy AI¹. Ask your device to do a few things at once, the same way you would naturally ask a person. Shoot and share your best memories with a powerful 50MP camera, powered by an advanced AI engine, with upgraded Nightography and Portrait Modes², for stunningly clear and natural images, day and night. Experience gaming and entertainment like never before with the latest chipset for faster speeds and extra power efficiency², and a self-optimising, long lasting battery to power you through your day.
descriptions: Enjoy getting more things done, the simpler way with Galaxy AI¹ on the Galaxy S25. Find a great pet-friendly restaurant nearby and message your friend to arrange a meeting time in a single step. Just ask in the natural way you would ask a person and it will process your request, performing complex tasks across multiple apps.

Take your best shots yet, day or night, on the Galaxy S25. Featuring an added range of up to 5x digital zoom in Portrait Mode and epic 50MP lens, the upgraded Nightography mode features 2-steps of noise reduction so you can shoot photos and video as clear as day, even when the sun goes down. Plus, the Galaxy S25 is now powered by an object-aware advanced AI engine¹, reducing light distortion to show your skin’s best natural glow.

You have the freedom of personalising your security settings and opting in-or-out of Galaxy AI features¹, for some added peace of mind. Knox Vault encryption ensures Galaxy AI on-device personalised data is secure and protected, so no other apps can access it.

Step up your style with the simply striking design of the Galaxy S25. Robustly designed, it features an IP68³ rating for water and dust resistance and strong Corning Gorilla Glass Victus 2⁴. Streamlined with classic curved edges for your comfort.

Enjoy performance that powers good times. The Galaxy S25 features an enhanced² built-in vapour chamber and the latest chipset, customised for Galaxy. It gives you faster speeds and extra power efficiency for seamless gaming and epic entertainment on-the-go, all powered by a self-optimising and long lasting battery that you can rely on.

Gaming never looked so good on the Galaxy S25. Immerse yourself in other worlds with a Dynamic AMOLED 2X display and AI-powered scaler¹, giving you better image quality and advanced ray tracing for unbelievable graphic detail.

title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold6 256GB Navy
description: With a new, sleek floating design and a large 6.3”, tablet-sized dual screen, Galaxy Z Fold6 is the next level in style, whilst being the slimmest and lightest Fold yet⁵. Enjoy a new age of productivity Galaxy AI features¹, such as instant search results just by circling your screen with Circle to Search², summarising your notes in just a tap with Note Assist³ and using Live Translate⁴ to listen or read to foreign languages in real time during calls. The upgraded Gorilla Glass Victus 2 cover screen⁷ provides protection from bumps and accidental scratches while armour aluminium⁸ casing on the cover and rear panel, a folding edge and a dual rail hinge make this a smartphone you can count on.
descriptions: Unfold a tablet-sized screen experience with a wide 6.3” cover screen and Vision Booster technology for a brighter display⁵ that optimises the screen for almost any light condition, so you get the best out of your entertainment anywhere.
12GB RAM.
256GB internal storage.

Circle to Search almost any text, images and video for instant results, right at your fingertips². Spotted some shoes you love on your feed? Just circle them on your screen to get instant search results, like the brand, where you can buy them and other relevant information.

Take your notes to the next level with Note Assist³ on Galaxy Z Fold6 and easily take notes on the go with an S Pen⁶. You can even take a voice recording in another language and instantly transcribe, translate, summarise and format it into clear, simple notes to revisit or share later.
Open up the main screen for the best entertainment experience and use dual screen interface to see two different applications, side by side for maximum multitasking productivity⁹.

An upgraded Gorilla Glass Victus 2 cover screen⁷ provides protection from bumps and accidental scratches while armour aluminium⁸ casing on the cover and rear panel, a folding edge and a dual rail hinge keep this smartphone running reliably.
The task bar lets you access your favourite apps quickly for an even more PC-like experience and easy multitasking.
Even in the lowest lights you can capture crisp, bright detail in your photos and videos with a 50MP lens and a new pro-visual engine that recognises objects, enhances colour tone and reduces noise.

If your shot needs a little more finesse, Galaxy AI Photo Assist¹⁰ takes the hassle out of editing with the ability to regenerate your image and fill in blank spaces as you resize and move objects in your photo around. Or bring a little slow-motion magic to your videos with the Instant Slo-mo feature¹¹.
An improved chipset and a bigger vapour chamber⁵ to keep things cool give you more time and power to browse, work and play.

The Adaptive Battery feature automatically optimises based on your usage patterns whilst the cover screen has a more efficient adaptive refresh rate, saving you precious battery life for the important things.
Simply connect to the network using a nano-SIM.
It comes with a 2 year warranty for added peace of mind.

It comes in a professional navy design.
This phone is a genuine product, is brand new and is not a refurbished model.

title: Samsung Galaxy Z Flip 7FE 128GB Jet Black
description: Get the best of pocket-sized power that’s also easy on your pocket with the new Galaxy Z Flip7 FE. It’s your new selfie game-changer with our all-time fave Flex Cam, featuring a 50MP wide lens and auto zoom for perfect framing, every time. Keep your cover screen fresh by creating customised wallpapers and enabling dynamic updates that display real-time events, like the weather¹, on screen. Whether you’re working, creating or enjoying downtime, the powerful, self-optimising battery will sail you through the longest days. Get comfy and go hands free while you’re watching content, taking video calls or capturing selfies at every angle with the versatile Flex Mode². Its sleek floating design is reinforced with Armour Aluminium and Gorilla Glass Victus³ so it’s ready for life’s little accidents. Now is the time to make the Flip.
descriptions: Bring your A-game to your selfies with Flex Cam on the new Galaxy Z Flip7 FE. With a bold 50MP wide camera and an auto zoom that recognises the subjects of the photo and adjusts them to fit, for the perfect shot.

title: Samsung Galaxy S25 Ultra 1TB Titanium Grey
description: With the new Galaxy S25 Ultra, you can tackle your day with ease with the help of even smarter Galaxy AI¹ while also capturing your biggest moments with unrivalled quality thanks to the advanced pro-visual engine and upgraded³ Nightography for pro-level shots, day and night. It’s new and sleek curved edge titanium design, Corning Gorilla Armour, an IP68² water and dust rating, and Knox Vault encryption, will ensure your device is safe and secure inside and out. Plus, you’ll be able to completely lose yourself in your favourite games with the expansive 6.9” display³ and lightning-fast speeds and improved power efficiency³.
descriptions: Enjoy getting more things done, the simpler way with Galaxy AI¹ - You can perform complex tasks across multiple apps, just by asking in a natural way like you would to a person. Plus, you can be ready for the day ahead from the moment you wake up, with Now Brief which delivers your personalised insights, from weather, news, health stats, to calendar reminders and more.

Shooting like a pro is simple – From capturing stunning landscapes, to super close-ups, the all new 50MP Ultrawide lens captures amazing photos whether they are ultra-wide or super close. Plus, it’s powered by the next-gen Pro Visual Engine to give you Ultra detail at every setting and upgraded Nightography features 2-steps of noise reduction so you can shoot videos as clear as day, even when the sun goes down.

Stay in control of your privacy – You have the freedom of personalising your security settings and opting in-or-out of Galaxy AI features¹, for some added peace of mind. Knox Vault encryption ensures Galaxy AI on-device personalised data is secure and protected, so no other apps can access it.

Sleek, premium and light – With new curved edges for your Ultra comfort, the Galaxy S25 Ultra is the ultimate in quality and elegant design, with a strong and light titanium frame⁴, an IP68² rating for water and dust resistance, and Corning Gorilla Armour⁵.

Enjoy performance that powers good times – the Galaxy S25 Ultra features an enhanced³ built-in vapour chamber and the latest chipset, customised for Galaxy. It gives you faster speeds and extra power efficiency³ for seamless gaming and epic entertainment on-the-go, all powered by a self-optimising and long-lasting battery that you can rely on.

Experience entertainment so immersive you might miss your stop – Stream, game, video-call and multi-task on its expansive 6.9” screen, Ultra’s biggest one yet. With superior brightness and advanced ray tracing for unbelievable graphic detail, and a Galaxy AI-powered scaler¹, so you can dominate every game.
The included Samsung S Pen will help you maximise your productivity.

Capture the moments worth keeping, from hitting the city with friends to that closeup of your pup, with the Galaxy Z Fold8 prograde 50MP dual camera. Every shot comes out vivid and sharp, powered by the ProVisual Engine³, so your best memories always look as good as they feel.

title: iPhone 17e 512GB Soft Pink
description: iPhone 17e features a beautiful 6.1-inch Super Retina XDR display¹, the fast and capable A19 chip, all-day battery life² and 256GB starting storage.
descriptions: SAY HELLO TO A GOOD BUY — iPhone 17e comes with many of the same great features as iPhone 17, at a wallet-friendly price.
ACTION BUTTON — Quick customisable access to your favourite apps and features, or use visual intelligence to learn about your surroundings.³
DESIGNED TO LAST — iPhone 17e is protected by Ceramic Shield 2 on the front, with 3x better scratch resistance than the previous generation.
STUNNING DISPLAY — The 6.1-inch Super Retina XDR display makes photos pop and text easy to read.¹ And the seven-layer antireflective coating reduces glare — even in bright sunlight.
ALL-DAY BATTERY LIFE — Text, browse, and binge movies and shows for hours on end.2 Charge fast with USB-C and now with MagSafe.

FAST WIRELESS CHARGING. ALL IN A SNAP WITH MAGSAFE. — iPhone 17e lets you charge wirelessly up to 15W, compared to 7.5W with iPhone 16e. That means when you need to charge, it’s easy, convenient and fast.⁴
A19 CHIP. BLASTS AND LASTS. — A19 makes everything you do feel fast and fluid for years to come — including powerful AAA gaming, 4K streaming and more.

TWO ADVANCED CAMERAS IN ONE — The 48MP Fusion camera delivers optical-quality 2x Telephoto. And next-generation portraits let you capture the moment in photos and turn them into beautiful portraits later by adding a background blur after the shot.

MORE SPACE FOR WHAT MATTERS — With 512GB storage, there’s plenty of room for everything you love, now and in the future — from super-high-resolution photos and 4K videos to your favourite apps, games and more.

PEACE OF MIND IN YOUR POCKET — If your car breaks down when you’re off the grid, you can get help with Roadside Assistance via satellite.⁵ And if you need emergency services and don’t have mobile reception or Wi Fi, you can use Emergency SOS via satellite.⁵ With Crash Detection, iPhone can detect a severe car crash and call for help if you can’t.⁶

IOS AND APPLE INTELLIGENCE. EFFORTLESSLY HELPFUL EVERY DAY.⁷ — Personal, private, powerful. Write, express yourself and get things done effortlessly with advanced features like Call Screening, Clean Up, Live Translation and visual intelligence.³
PRIVACY — Use Face ID to securely unlock, sign in and pay.

title: iPhone 16 Plus 128GB Pink
description: iPhone 16 Plus. Built for Apple Intelligence.¹ Featuring Camera Control. 48MP Fusion camera. Five vibrant colours. And A18 chip.
descriptions: BUILT FOR APPLE INTELLIGENCE — Apple Intelligence is the personal intelligence system that helps you write, express yourself and get things done effortlessly. With groundbreaking privacy protections, it gives you peace of mind that no-one else can access your data — not even Apple.¹
TAKE TOTAL CAMERA CONTROL — Camera Control gives you an easier way to quickly access camera tools, like zoom or depth of field, so you can take the perfect shot in record time.

GET FURTHER AND CLOSER — The improved Ultra Wide camera with autofocus lets you take incredibly detailed macro photos and videos. Use the 48MP Fusion camera for stunning high-resolution images, and zoom in with the 2x optical-quality Telephoto.

PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLES — The latest-generation Photographic Styles give you greater creative flexibility, so you can make every photo even more you. And you can reverse any of those styles any time you want.

SUPERSMART A18 CHIP — A18 jumps two generations ahead of the A16 Bionic chip in iPhone 15. It enables Apple Intelligence, powers advanced photo and video features, and supports console-level gaming, with exceptional power efficiency.

LONGER BATTERY LIFE — iPhone 16 Plus works together with the A18 chip to deliver a big boost in battery life with up to 27 hours video playback.² Charge via USB-C or snap on a MagSafe charger for faster wireless charging.³

DESIGNED TO LAST — iPhone 16 Plus has a sturdy, aerospace-grade aluminium design with a 6.7-inch Super Retina XDR display.⁴ It’s remarkably durable, with the latest-generation Ceramic Shield material that’s 2x tougher than any smartphone glass.

CUSTOMISE YOUR IPHONE — With iOS 18 you can tint your Home Screen icons with any colour. Find your favourite shots faster in the redesigned Photos app. And add playful, animated effects to any word, phrase or emoji in iMessage.⁵

VITAL SAFETY FEATURES — If you need emergency services and you don’t have mobile service or Wi-Fi, you can use Emergency SOS via satellite.⁶ With Crash Detection, iPhone can detect a severe car crash and call for help if you can’t.⁷

title: Google Pixel 10A 128GB Obsidian
description: Meet Google Pixel 10a. Brilliant photography, helpful AI¹ and a durable design. It’s got all the essentials, plus features you’ll love.
descriptions: Lasts for years and years: A battery that lasts for 30+ hours,² 7 years of updates from launch,³ and a durable design make Google Pixel 10a perfect for wherever life takes you.

Smooth by design: With a completely flat design, Google Pixel 10a is super sleek. The camera blends seamlessly into the back of the phone, making it comfortable to hold and easy to pocket. It lies perfectly flat wherever you place it and comes in a palette of colours to fit your personal style.

More than a day of battery, no extra charge: Get 30+ hours out of a full charge, or turn on Extreme Battery Saver for up to 120 hours of power.² Fast charging is built in, so you can stay connected and keep doing your thing.⁴
Holds space for what you love: 128GB storage for plenty of space for your photos, apps and memories.⁵
Durable for years to come: Google Pixel 10a holds up against scratches and spills thanks to IP68 water and dust protection,⁶ durable materials, and a tough Corning Gorilla Glass display.

An upgrade that keeps upgrading: Your Pixel devices get even more helpful with Pixel Drops. They’re automatic software updates that send new and upgraded features to your phone, so your Pixel keeps feeling fresh. And they’re guaranteed for up to seven years from launch.³
Security and OS updates for 7 years from launch: To protect you and your sensitive data, Pixel gets regular software updates, helping to make your phone even more secure over time.³
See the screen clear as day: The 6.3-inch Actua display is sharp, vibrant and bright. It runs fast, up to 120Hz, for smooth gaming, scrolling and switching between apps.⁷

Designed with the planet in mind: Google Pixel 10a is made with the most recycled material of any Google Pixel A-Series phone yet.⁸ For the first time, it includes recycled cobalt, copper, gold and tungsten. It has a 100% recycled aluminium frame – for a lower carbon footprint – and a back cover made up of 81% recycled plastic.⁹ Plus, the packaging is 100% plastic-free.¹⁰

Take extraordinary photos every day: Capture crisp details up close and in low light with the amazing features of the Google Pixel 10a camera. Snap beautiful shots easily, get everyone into the group pic and take photos where everyone looks their best.¹¹

More time for you. That’s why Google AI: Google AI handles the details so you can get back to what’s important. Have it screen calls while you focus.¹² Chat with Gemini to brainstorm your weekly meal plan,¹ or see what your selfie would look like in another decade with Nano Banana.¹,¹³
Pixel helps you avoid unwanted calls: Call Screen can detect and filter out spam calls. It answers unknown numbers and finds out who’s calling and why – you can decide whether to pick up.¹²
Help making calls. And avoiding them: Lean on Pixel Call Assist, a set of features that makes calls sound clearer and helps you avoid spammers with Call Screen, Hold for Me and more.¹²

The power behind AI on Google Pixel: The Google Tensor G4 chip is custom-built for Pixel to power all you do – like snapping brilliant photos and videos and using our advanced AI, including Gemini. It makes Pixel fast, efficient and helpful.

Pixel helps protect you and your sensitive info: With real-time security checks, Pixel gives you continuous protection online,¹⁴ theft protection and regular security updates for 7 years from launch.³ It also has Car Crash Detection¹⁵ and Crisis Alerts¹⁶ to help keep you and your family safe.
wirelessProtocol: Wi-Fi 6E with 2.4 GHz, 5 GHz, 6 GHz, 2x2 MIMO

title: Google Pixel 9a 128GB Obsidian
description: Meet Pixel 9a – engineered by Google. With Gemini built in to supercharge your productivity and creativity.¹ An incredible camera. All-day battery.² Durable design. And 7 years of updates from launch so it keeps feeling new.³
descriptions: Take one with the group, then swap in the photographer, and Pixel magically merges both photos.⁴

Pixel 9a is designed to handle spills, dust, drops and dings.⁵ From IP68 water and dust protection to a scratch-resistant display and long-lasting materials, it’s the most durable Pixel A-Series phone yet.
Save time by asking Gemini to find information and get things done for you across your Google apps – like Maps, Calendar, Gmail and YouTube Music. It’s multitasking made easy.¹
The Adaptive Battery on Pixel 9a can last over 30 hours. Need even more? Turn on Extreme Battery Saver to make it last up to 100. That’s big energy.²
Take photos and videos so amazing, you won’t believe you actually took them. Capture small details, create perfect group shots and even get vivid ones at night.
Night Sight takes sharp, vivid photos, portraits and panos in low light, like concerts and cityscapes – even the Milky Way with Astrophotography.
Get an amazing group photo by combining similar photos. Pixel finds the best moment, or you can choose everyone’s best expression.
Your new Pixel comes with OS and security updates for 7 years from launch, and new and upgraded features with Pixel Drops.³
Magic Editor in Google Photos makes complex edits easy. With a few taps, AI can change the background, move objects and more.
Pixel is built with safety features that help you prepare and react in an emergency. It can quickly call emergency services and share accurate location info so they know where to send help.⁶

description: Meet Google Pixel 10a. Brilliant photography, helpful AI¹ and a durable design. It’s got all the essentials, plus features you’ll love.
descriptions: Lasts for years and years: A battery that lasts for 30+ hours,² 7 years of updates from launch,³ and a durable design make Google Pixel 10a perfect for wherever life takes you.

Smooth by design: With a completely flat design, Google Pixel 10a is super sleek. The camera blends seamlessly into the back of the phone, making it comfortable to hold and easy to pocket. It lies perfectly flat wherever you place it and comes in a palette of colours to fit your personal style.

More than a day of battery, no extra charge: Get 30+ hours out of a full charge, or turn on Extreme Battery Saver for up to 120 hours of power.² Fast charging is built in, so you can stay connected and keep doing your thing.⁴
Holds space for what you love: 256GB storage for plenty of space for your photos, apps and memories.⁵
Durable for years to come: Google Pixel 10a holds up against scratches and spills thanks to IP68 water and dust protection,⁶ durable materials, and a tough Corning Gorilla Glass display.

An upgrade that keeps upgrading: Your Pixel devices get even more helpful with Pixel Drops. They’re automatic software updates that send new and upgraded features to your phone, so your Pixel keeps feeling fresh. And they’re guaranteed for up to seven years from launch.³
Security and OS updates for 7 years from launch: To protect you and your sensitive data, Pixel gets regular software updates, helping to make your phone even more secure over time.³
See the screen clear as day: The 6.3-inch Actua display is sharp, vibrant and bright. It runs fast, up to 120Hz, for smooth gaming, scrolling and switching between apps.⁷

Designed with the planet in mind: Google Pixel 10a is made with the most recycled material of any Google Pixel A-Series phone yet.⁸ For the first time, it includes recycled cobalt, copper, gold and tungsten. It has a 100% recycled aluminium frame – for a lower carbon footprint – and a back cover made up of 81% recycled plastic.⁹ Plus, the packaging is 100% plastic-free.¹⁰

Take extraordinary photos every day: Capture crisp details up close and in low light with the amazing features of the Google Pixel 10a camera. Snap beautiful shots easily, get everyone into the group pic and take photos where everyone looks their best.¹¹

More time for you. That’s why Google AI: Google AI handles the details so you can get back to what’s important. Have it screen calls while you focus.¹² Chat with Gemini to brainstorm your weekly meal plan,¹ or see what your selfie would look like in another decade with Nano Banana.¹,¹³
Pixel helps you avoid unwanted calls: Call Screen can detect and filter out spam calls. It answers unknown numbers and finds out who’s calling and why – you can decide whether to pick up.¹²
Help making calls. And avoiding them: Lean on Pixel Call Assist, a set of features that makes calls sound clearer and helps you avoid spammers with Call Screen, Hold for Me and more.¹²

The power behind AI on Google Pixel: The Google Tensor G4 chip is custom-built for Pixel to power all you do – like snapping brilliant photos and videos and using our advanced AI, including Gemini. It makes Pixel fast, efficient and helpful.

Pixel helps protect you and your sensitive info: With real-time security checks, Pixel gives you continuous protection online,¹⁴ theft protection and regular security updates for 7 years from launch.³ It also has Car Crash Detection¹⁵ and Crisis Alerts¹⁶ to help keep you and your family safe.

title: Google Pixel 9 Pro XL 5G Smartphone 256GB Porcelain
description: Meet the Pixel 9 Pro XL. It has a sleek, stunning design and it's the most powerful Pixel yet. Take pro-level photos and videos with the triple camera system and make expert edits. And it's engineered by Google, so it gets the best of Google’s AI first.
descriptions: Google Tensor G4 is Pixel's most powerful chip yet. It's built for advanced AI like Gemini, cutting-edge photos and videos and smarter ways to help all day.¹
Designed for the fastest performance on a Pixel, Pixel 9 Pro XL has 16 GB of RAM to power Google's most advanced AI.
With the brightest, most immersive Pixel display yet, you'll see true-to-life colours, even in sunlight. And it runs up to 120 Hz, for smooth gaming and scrolling.²
The Pixel 9 Pro XL battery can last over 24 hours, and up to 100 hours with Extreme Battery Saver.³ And it can charge to 70% in about 30 minutes. ⁴
Pixel is designed to handle everyday spills and dust.⁵ And the display is scratch and damage resistant, made with Corning® Gorilla® Glass Victus®.
The triple rear camera is the most powerful Pixel Camera ever. Get up close with 30x Super Res Zoom.⁶ And it has super-sharp, high-res video quality, even in low light and from far away.
Gemini helps you supercharge your ideas. Hold the power button to start writing, planning, learning and more.⁷
If you're in an emergency, press the power button five times. Pixel can call the emergency services and share your location with contacts.⁸
Call Screen can detect and filter out spam calls. It answers unknown numbers and finds out who's calling and why – you can decide whether to pick up.⁹
Your Pixel gets a boost of helpfulness with automatic Pixel Drops.¹⁰ They include new camera features, helpful tools and more. So your Pixel keeps getting better over time.
Pixel 9 Pro XL contains recycled metals, glass and plastic.¹¹ The Pixel frame is 100% recycled aluminium.¹² And the packaging is 100% plastic-free.¹³

title: Apple AirTag 4 Pack
description: Keep track of your everyday items with the Apple AirTag, a simple and secure way to locate your belongings. Whether it’s your keys, backpack or luggage, just attach an AirTag and use the Find My app to see its location. It’s easy to set up, water-resistant, and designed to protect your privacy every step of the way.
descriptions: Effortless Setup – Connects instantly with your iPhone or iPad via one-tap setup.
Precision Finding – Uses Ultra Wideband technology to guide you directly to your item (on supported devices).
Find My Network – Leverages hundreds of millions of Apple devices to help locate lost items, even when they’re far away.
Privacy Built-In – Location data and history are never stored on the AirTag itself.
Durable Design – Water- and dust-resistant with a replaceable battery that lasts over a year.
More Ways to Stay Organised – With four AirTags in one pack, you can keep track of multiple items like your keys, wallet, backpack and suitcase, all from one place in the Find My app.

title: AirTag (2nd Generation) 4 Pack
description: AirTag (2nd generation) now has its loudest speaker yet and an expanded Precision Finding range¹ to make it easier than ever to find your items. Attach one to your keys, slip another in your bag. And track all your items in the Find My app. ¹
descriptions: FIND YOUR ITEMS ON FIND MY - AirTag (2nd generation) helps you keep track of what matters. Attach one to any item you want, and keep track of it using the Find My app. ¹
EXPANDED PRECISION FINDING ON IPHONE AND APPLE WATCH - Get step-by-step directions to your lost item on iPhone and now, Apple Watch. ¹
ENHANCED SPEAKER - With a 50 per cent louder speaker and a new, distinctive chime, it’s easier than ever to hear and find AirTag. ¹
PING FROM FAR AND WIDE - Upgraded Ultra Wideband and Bluetooth® chips allow you to find your items from even farther away than ever before. ¹
SHARE ITEM LOCATION - Share AirTag location access temporarily and securely with trusted contacts, third parties or over 50 airline partners if you lose something important.
BATTERY LIFE - AirTag (2nd generation) works for more than a year on a standard battery you can easily replace when your iPhone alerts you. ²
SAFE, SOUND, FOUND - Only you or authorised users can see your AirTag location, and your location data and history are never stored on AirTag itself.
MORE SUSTAINABLE DESIGN - The latest AirTag features 85 per cent post-consumer recycled plastic in the enclosure and 100 per cent fibre-based packaging. ³
